concepts.why: The answer applies the rule that the test runs before each pass to this code: the pass that sets isDone finishes, then the next test fails. It gives no actual values or output (1 4 7 10), so it stays at L2.
The answer correctly applies the update i = i + 3 to this loop variable, but it does not relate the start value, the test and the update to each other.
The answer says nothing about statements or the order they run in.
The answer says nothing about loop bounds or off-by-one errors.
